name: Electric Pressure Washer
definition: A mains-powered household or light-duty pressure washer that uses an electric motor and pump to pressurize supplied water for manufacturer-declared outdoor cleaning tasks.
includedScope: Corded household and light-duty cold-water pressure washers
Portable, wheeled and compact jobsite-style electric formats
excludedScope: Battery-only low-pressure cleaners and specialist water-jetting systems
primaryApplications: Manufacturer-approved patios, paths, outdoor furniture and exterior surfaces
Model-approved vehicles, tools and garden equipment
headline: Electric pressure washer pressure, flow, nozzles and electrical checks
description: This profile separates rated and maximum pressure, flow at stated pressure, motor and pump, hose and cord reach, GFCI, nozzles, detergent delivery, water inlet and surface risk so buyers can compare electric pressure washers on equivalent evidence.
metaDescription: Electric pressure washer guide covering pumps, pressure, flow, GFCI, nozzles, models, safety and buyer checks.
disclaimer: This independent category reference is not electrical, water-system, surface, chemical or safety advice. High-pressure jets can cause severe injury and material damage. Confirm the exact regional model, circuit, GFCI/RCD, water supply, hose, gun, lance, nozzle, detergent, inlet limit, surface method and manual before procurement or use.

keyFacts.label: Category boundary
keyFacts.value: Mains-powered cold-water pressure washer for declared household or light-duty tasks
keyFacts.evidence: Official pages identify corded electric motors, pumps and model-specific outdoor applications.
keyFacts.scope: Named models; engine, hot-water and battery-only machines excluded.

keyFacts.label: Comparison boundary
keyFacts.value: Match pressure and flow at the same declared operating point
keyFacts.evidence: Greenworks separately states 1.2 GPM at 2300 PSI and 2.3 GPM at 100 PSI; other brands publish different definitions.
keyFacts.scope: Exact source statement and nozzle configuration.

systemFlow.name: Electrical drive and water inlet
systemFlow.componentFamily: Mains circuit, GFCI/RCD, cord, switch, motor, inlet filter and supply hose
systemFlow.role: Powers the pump and provides water within the declared inlet conditions.
systemFlow.evidence: Official pages and manuals publish model-specific electrical and water-supply requirements.
systemFlow.scope: Exact voltage, market, circuit and inlet.

systemFlow.name: Pressurization and spray delivery
systemFlow.componentFamily: Pump, high-pressure hose, trigger gun, lance, nozzle and detergent system
systemFlow.role: Raises water pressure and forms the selected spray pattern.
systemFlow.evidence: Manufacturers publish distinct pumps, hoses, nozzles and detergent arrangements.
systemFlow.scope: Exact rated assemblies and operating limits.

variants.name: Wheeled household upright
variants.taskScale: Outdoor household cleaning across patios, paths, vehicles and furniture where approved
variants.operatorRelationship: User rolls the machine, routes cord and hose, and selects pressure or nozzle for the surface
variants.spaceConstraints: Outlet, water tap, cord, hose, wheels, reel and storage footprint
variants.limitations: Maximum pressure does not establish surface safety or sustained duty.
variants.evidence: Kärcher, Greenworks, RYOBI and STIHL publish wheeled corded formats.

variants.name: Compact framed electric washer
variants.taskScale: Portable household or light jobsite exterior cleaning
variants.operatorRelationship: User carries or wheels a compact frame with internally stored spray equipment
variants.spaceConstraints: Stable placement, ventilation, cord and hose routing, stack or shelf dimensions
variants.limitations: Compact packaging does not establish commercial duty cycle.
variants.evidence: DEWALT publishes a compact self-contained DWPW2100 format.
variants.scope: DWPW2100 and comparable exact models only.

performanceMetrics.name: Pressure and flow
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Defines the stated hydraulic operating point and affects jet impact and rinsing volume
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Rated, working, maximum and nozzle-qualified values must remain separate
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Do not multiply unrelated maximum pressure and maximum flow values into a performance ranking.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Official pages publish different pressure and flow conventions.
performanceMetrics.scope: Exact model, nozzle and declared point.

performanceMetrics.name: Reach, electrical load and inlet
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Determines setup feasibility, circuit suitability and pump water supply
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Cord and hose lengths, amperage or power, voltage and inlet temperature are separate constraints
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Long reach or motor input does not establish cleaning result or duty cycle.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Manufacturers publish exact-model cord, hose, voltage, motor and inlet data.

applicationFit.application: Patios, paths and durable exterior surfaces
applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Trial the least aggressive approved nozzle and distance on a concealed representative area.
applicationFit.basis: Material, joints, coating, pressure, flow, angle, distance and dwell interact.
applicationFit.limitations: An application icon does not guarantee zero erosion, etching or water intrusion.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Record nozzle, distance, pressure setting, detergent, area rate and surface change.
applicationFit.evidence: Manufacturers identify applications while manuals warn about safe technique.

applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Confirm the manufacturer-approved nozzle, distance and detergent before a small-area trial.
applicationFit.basis: Paint, seals, bearings, electrical components and soft materials can be damaged by concentrated jets.
applicationFit.limitations: Vehicle or furniture wording does not approve every component or finish.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Protect sensitive areas and document water and chemical controls.
applicationFit.evidence: Official product pages list qualified applications and spray equipment.

componentStack.name: Circuit, motor, pump and inlet
componentStack.role: Supplies electrical and hydraulic input and raises water pressure.
criticalChecks: Inlet flow, pressure, temperature and filter
Pump material, shutdown and storage procedure
componentStack.evidence: Official sources publish materially different motor and inlet arrangements.
componentStack.scope: Exact regional model; no duty inference.

componentStack.name: Hose, gun, lance and nozzle
componentStack.role: Contains high-pressure water and forms the spray pattern at the target.
criticalChecks: Trigger lock, hose inspection and pressure release
componentStack.evidence: Manufacturers publish model-specific spray equipment and safety procedures.
componentStack.scope: No cross-brand hose, gun, lance or nozzle compatibility.

representativeModels.subtype: Wheeled household pressure washer with surface-cleaner kit
representativeModels.evidence: Kärcher publishes exact regional technical data and accessories.
Greenworks publishes separate operating points and equipment.
DEWALT publishes qualified pressure, flow and included equipment.
RYOBI publishes the named specifications and intended applications.

representativeModels.subtype: Induction-motor corded pressure washer with hose reel
representativeModels.evidence: STIHL publishes exact performance and equipment data.
Bosch publishes the named product features and regional manual.

procurementDecisions.intendedTask: Clean outdoor surfaces without avoidable damage
procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Pressure-flow point, nozzle, distance, detergent and area rate
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Ranking by maximum PSI or cleaning-units arithmetic alone
procurementDecisions.assessment: Run a controlled representative-area trial with the least aggressive setup.
procurementDecisions.limitations: Catalogue metrics do not guarantee outcome or productivity.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Record nozzle, pressure, flow basis, distance, dwell, water and result.
procurementDecisions.evidence: Official sources publish qualified specifications and applications.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Circuit, GFCI/RCD, inlet, hose, nozzles, seals and service parts
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Assuming connector appearance establishes accessory interchangeability
procurementDecisions.assessment: Attach exact electrical, water and part codes to the quote.
procurementDecisions.basis: Safety-critical assemblies and ratings are model-specific.
procurementDecisions.limitations: Future part supply is not guaranteed.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Obtain circuit requirements, part numbers, lead times, warranty and winterization procedure.
procurementDecisions.evidence: Manuals and product pages identify exact systems.

engineeringChecks.reason: Wet outdoor use creates shock risk if circuit protection, plugs, cords or handling are wrong.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Have the exact circuit and GFCI/RCD arrangement checked against the manual and local rules.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Official manuals and product pages specify protected corded configurations.

engineeringChecks.reason: Wrong hose, gun, nozzle or trapped pressure can cause injection injury or component failure.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Verify ratings and codes; inspect before use and release pressure exactly as instructed.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Manufacturer manuals and safety guidance define high-pressure controls.

standards.name: IEC 60335-2-79
standards.applicability: Particular safety requirements for high-pressure cleaners and steam cleaners for household and commercial use.
standards.evidence: IEC publishes the standard scope; exact product conformity remains market- and model-specific.
standards.scope: Use the applicable edition and national adoption; this page does not certify any product.

developments.evidence: Greenworks hosts the dated official operator manual.
